pages.text: A $(item)Telephone$() touching a $(l:radiocraft:microwave/microwave_radio)microwave radio$(/l), or on its $(l:radiocraft:radios/data_wire)data wire$(/l), can call any phone on the same radio or at the far end of its links. Place it on top of a block for a desk phone, or against the side of one to hang it on the wall.$(br2)Each phone has an $(thing)extension$(). Key a number and press CALL; the far phone rings for 30 seconds.

pages.title: Talking
pages.text: $(thing)Sneak and right click$() with an empty hand to pick up the handset: it answers a ringing phone, and only you are heard, with the far end at your ear. The cord reaches 5 blocks. Sneak and right click with the handset to hang up.$(br2)Left on its cradle the phone is a speakerphone: CALL answers, anyone close by is heard, HANG ends it.

pages.title: Extensions
pages.text: The other end sounds clean and a little fuller than SSB. Interference or a weak link makes it break up.$(br2)To change a phone's extension press EXT, key the new number and CALL. No two phones that can reach each other may share one.
